gb.ready.text: Hi, I'm Gloop! Will you help with my bubble bath?

gb.back.text: Welcome back! The bubbles are waiting for you.

gb.story.1.text: Splish, splash! It's Gloop's bath time before bed.

gb.story.2.text: But oh dear! The bath is overflowing with toys.

gb.story.3.text: Ducks, boats, shapes and bubbles, all in a muddle!

gb.story.4.text: Let's help Gloop and Bobbo tidy, count and compare.

gb.story.mid1.text: The toys are getting tidy. Gloop wiggles happily!

gb.story.mid2.text: Halfway there! The bubbles are sparkling.

gb.story.mid3.text: Nearly done! Get ready for the bubble parade.

gb.story.end1.text: The bath is calm and clean. Every toy has its place.

gb.story.end2.text: Gloop is snug in a fluffy towel. Time for bed!

gb.story.end3.text: You looked, matched and kept trying. Here's your Bubble Buddy sticker!

gb.prompt.sort.text: Put each toy in the hole with the same shape!

gb.prompt.look.text: Watch the bubbles. How many did you see?

gb.prompt.compare.moreSame.text: Which tub has more ducks? Or are they the same?

gb.prompt.compare.fewerSame.text: Which tub has fewer ducks? Or are they the same?

gb.prompt.size.boat.text: Line up the boats, from smallest to biggest!

gb.prompt.size.sponge.text: Line up the sponges, from smallest to biggest!

gb.prompt.parade.text: Bubble parade! Pop them in counting order: one, two, three!

gb.prompt.parade.count.text: Bubble parade! Pop every bubble and count. How many?

gb.parade.howMany.text: All popped! How many bubbles did you pop?

gb.check.text: All done? Press the green button to check!

gb.help.sort.text: Look at the corners. Each toy fits the hole with the same shape.

gb.help.find.text: Circles are round. Squares have four corners. Triangles have three.

gb.help.tipped.text: Shapes can turn and tip. Count the corners to know them!

gb.help.parade.text: Pop the bubbles in counting order: one, two, three!

gb.help.look.peek.text: Look for little groups! Tap the eye to see the bubbles again.

gb.help.compare.pair.text: Tap the duck button to give each duck a partner. Leftovers mean more!

gb.help.compare.trap.text: A long line can trick you. Tap the duck button to pair them!

gb.help.size.undo.text: Find the smallest first, then the next. The arrow button takes one back.

gb.help.find2.text: Circles are round, with no corners. Squares have four corners.

gb.help.parade.count.text: Pop each bubble once. Count as you go: one, two, three!

gb.hint.shape.circle.text: A circle is round all the way. It has no corners!

gb.hint.shape.square.text: A square has four corners and four sides, all the same.

gb.hint.shape.triangle.text: A triangle has three corners. Count them: one, two, three!

gb.hint.shape.tipped.text: A tipped shape is still the same shape. Count its corners!

gb.hint.shape.skinny.text: A long, thin triangle is still a triangle. Three corners!

gb.hint.compare.more.text: More means the tub with ducks left over. Let's pair them up.

gb.hint.compare.fewer.text: Fewer means not as many. Let's pair them up and see.

gb.hint.compare.same.text: Look! Every duck has a partner. Nobody is left over.

gb.hint.compare.notSame.text: Let's pair them up. Is a duck left over?

gb.hint.compare.long.text: A longer line can still have fewer. Pair the ducks up!

gb.hint.size.reverse.text: Small first! The tiniest one goes at the start.

gb.hint.size.middle.text: Check the middle ones. Each one is a little bigger.

gb.hint.size.start.text: Find the smallest one first. Then the next smallest.

gb.hint.parade.skip.text: Oops, a number got skipped. Count with me from one!

gb.hint.yourTurn.text: Your turn! Press the glowing one.

gb.hint.look.tooMany.text: Not that many. Look at the little groups.

gb.hint.look.tooFew.text: There were more. Look at the little groups.

gb.hint.parade.numbers.text: Look at the numbers! Find one, then two.

gb.hint.parade.last.text: Listen for the last number you counted. That tells how many!

gb.hint.shape.lopsided.text: A lopsided triangle is still a triangle. Count three corners!

gb.retry.text: Hmm, not quite. Let's look again.

gb.praise.sort.1.text: Every toy in its hole. You looked at the corners!

gb.praise.sort.2.text: You checked each shape before it went in!

gb.praise.find.1.text: You found the {kind}! You looked really closely.

gb.praise.find.2.text: You looked at each shape carefully!

gb.praise.look.2.text: You spotted the little groups and put them together!

gb.praise.compare.same.text: Every duck has a partner, so they're the same!

gb.praise.size.1.text: Smallest to biggest! You compared each one.

gb.praise.size.2.text: You checked the sizes, one by one!

gb.praise.parade.1.text: You popped them in counting order, all the way!

gb.praise.parade.2.text: One, two, three and on! You counted in order.

gb.praise.compare.looked.text: You compared the two tubs. Great checking!

gb.praise.parade.count.text: {nWord}! You popped each bubble once and counted them all.

gb.idle.text: Gloop is waiting. Tap or drag to help!

gb.idle.look.text: Tap the eye to see the bubbles again.

gb.idle.compare.text: Tap the duck button to give each duck a partner.

gb.idle.size.text: Tap the smallest one first. The arrow button takes one back.

gb.idle.sort.text: Tap a toy, then tap its hole. Or drag it in!

gb.idle.parade.text: Find number one and pop it!

gb.idle.paradeCount.text: Pop each bubble once, and count!
